meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: Claude 会多出一个 Dial 渠道:一个真实手机号,能收发短信,并用 AI 接听语音来电。出站经 `dial message`,入站由 CLI 的事件守护进程转给适配器。
howto.when: 当你运行 add-dial 技能、要为本机添加 Dial 手机号渠道时触发;它负责复制适配器、登录 Dial 并注册号码。

say.text: 帮我装好 Dial 渠道,给我一个能收发短信、接电话的手机号
say.note: 会复制适配器、安装 dial CLI 并引导登录

say.text: 把这个号码设为只允许我配对的那个手机号发消息进来
给这个号码设置来电时的 AI 问候语
say.note: 设置来电使用的系统提示词

howto.what_en: Claude gains a Dial channel: a real phone number that sends/receives SMS and answers AI voice calls. Outbound goes through `dial message`; inbound arrives via the CLI's command-target daemon.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run the add-dial skill to add a Dial phone-number channel to this install — it copies the adapter, signs in to Dial, and registers the line.

say_en.text: Set up the Dial channel and give me a number for SMS and calls
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dial CLI, starts sign-in

say_en.text: Make this line owner-only, so just my paired phone can text it
Set the inbound call greeting for this number
say_en.note: Sets the AI prompt used on inbound calls
